notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The wire plane exists: CMSG_QUESTGIVER_STATUS_QUERY is sendable (QuestgiverStatus, range-gated through QuestGate), SMSG_QUESTGIVER_STATUS is parsed into a per-giver status map, and a status re-ask fires when a quest panel closes. But the module's actual player-visible product - the floating TalkToMe `!`/`?` markers over NPC heads - does not exist, and statuses are only ever asked for NPCs the player already interacted with.
